rules.label: A parent with sole custody may act alone.

law_references.quote: A parent represents his or her child alone if: 1) he or she has sole legal custody of the child, or 2) the powers of decision have been transferred to him or her pursuant to § 119 of this Act.
law_references.note: This is the first explicit single-parent basis.

rules.label: A parent with delegated decision right may act alone.

law_references.quote: A parent represents his or her child alone if: 1) he or she has sole legal custody of the child, or 2) the powers of decision have been transferred to him or her pursuant to § 119 of this Act.
law_references.note: This is the second explicit single-parent basis.

rules.label: A parent may act alone in an emergency.

law_references.quote: If making a joint declaration of intention of the parents would cause a delay in conflict with the interests of the child, one parent has the right to enter into necessary transactions and perform necessary acts in the interests of the child also alone.
law_references.note: The urgent scenario is the user-facing demonstration rule.

rules.label: A parent may act with both parents' consent.

law_references.quote: Parents shall exercise joint legal custody with respect to their child and perform the custodial obligation on their own responsibility and unanimously considering all-round well-being of the child. Parents who have joint legal custody have a joint right of representation.
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 118 (1) and § 120 (1)”. This captures the joint representation baseline.

rules.label: If one parent is unreachable, confirmed joint consent is unavailable.

law_references.quote: If making a joint declaration of intention of the parents would cause a delay in conflict with the interests of the child, one parent has the right to enter into necessary transactions and perform necessary acts in the interests of the child also alone.
law_references.note: A simplification used to keep the trace readable.

rules.label: A non-parent cannot give the permission.

law_references.quote: A parent who has legal custody is the legal representative of a child. Parents who have joint legal custody have a joint right of representation.
law_references.note: This guards the case against third-party requests.

law_references.note: Baseline Estonian-citizen path under § 14(1).

rules.label: EU-citizen path to appointment (§ 14 (2)).

law_references.quote: A citizen of a Member State of the European Union who conforms to the requirements established by law and on the basis thereof may also be employed in the service.
law_references.note: Alternative EU-citizen path under § 14(2).

rules.label: Conviction for an intentional crime blocks appointment (§ 15 1)).

law_references.quote: The following person may not be employed in service: 1) who is under punishment for an intentionally committed criminal offence;
law_references.note: Statutory bar for intentional-crime conviction.

rules.label: Journalism basis (§ 4, first sentence) without consent.

law_references.quote: Personal data may be processed and disclosed in the media for journalistic purposes without the consent of the data subject, in particular disclosed in the media, if there is public interest and this is in accordance with the principles of journalism ethics.
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4, first sentence”. Three-condition journalism basis.

rules.label: Consent baseline under the Personal Data Protection Act.

law_references.quote: Personal data may be processed and disclosed in the media for journalistic purposes without the consent of the data subject ...
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4 (implicit consent baseline)”. Consent is the general baseline; the journalism basis is its exception.

rules.label: Excessive harm defeats ethics compliance (§ 4, second sentence).

law_references.quote: Disclosure of personal data must not cause excessive damage to the rights of any data subjects.
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4, second sentence”. Proportionality override of the ethics condition.
